multifit.plot module

Usage: multifit plot CONFIG [LOG] [–color MAP [–import MODULE]]

[–xlabel LABEL] [–ylabel LABEL] [–callnumber N] [–background INDEX] [–no-normalize]

CONFIG yaml configuration file. LOG json log file generated by multifit fit.

-h –help Print this help screen and exit.

Plotting options:

-x –xlabel LABEL Label on the x axis. [default: value] -y –ylabel LABEL Label on the y axis. [default: counts per bin] -c –color MAP Name of the colormap to use. [default: viridis] -i –import MODULE Use a third party colormap from MODULE. –no-normalize Don’t nomralize the histogram.

Fit selection options (only relevant if LOG is provided):
--callnumber N

Number of the migrad iteration to plot. Starts at 1, supports reverse indexing. [default: -1]

-b –background INDEX

Use this component of the model cdf as the background when plotting.
